title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: OpenAI and Anthropic Insiders Fear Their Next AI Models Are Too Dangerous to Release
summary: Employees at both AI labs reportedly question whether their strongest models should ever reach the public, as researchers struggle to keep increasingly capable systems under control during training and testing.

title: Anthropic’s Claude Ship Lets AI Write, Review and Approve Its Own Code
summary: Anthropic’s new coding tools can review and repair software changes before approving them for release, leaving development teams to decide when a human still needs to check the AI’s work.

title: South Korea Moves to Lift Its ICO Ban After Nearly a Decade
summary: The Financial Services Commission’s draft Digital Asset Act would let domestic projects sell tokens again under IPO-style disclosure rules, reversing a 2017 ban that mostly pushed Korean issuers offshore.

title: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
summary: The study will assess whether a shared ledger can bring central bank money, commercial bank money and securities onto the same platform.
